articles.author: GlobeNewswire / Nexera Technologies
articles.headline: Nexera: KeepZone AI Receives Official Authorization to Introduce Advanced Fuel Tank Structural Survivability System in the Gulf Region
articles.summary: Nexera anuncia que KeepZone recibió autorización de un proveedor para presentar su sistema de protección de depósitos de combustible y mantener conversaciones con clientes del Golfo. La autorización comercial no equivale a un contrato público, pedidos confirmados o ingresos realizados.

articles.author: GlobeNewswire
articles.headline: Nexera Technologies Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Listing Approval for Majority-Owned Subsidiary Fort Technology
sourceWarnings: Discrepancia de fecha documental: el anexo SEC posterior dice 3 de junio, mientras el distribuidor publicó el 4 a las 08:23 ET. Se usa la fecha de publicación verificada del distribuidor.
articles.summary: Nexera announced Nasdaq listing approval for its majority-owned Fort subsidiary, with trading expected later. A later SEC exhibit labels the release June 3, while the distributor dates it June 4; this record uses the verified June 4 publication and does not treat expected trading as already begun.
articles.timestampEvidence: Original GlobeNewswire header explicitly June 04, 2026 08:23 ET. Later SEC exhibit description says June 3; it is not evidence of an earlier public posting.

articles.author: Nexera Technologies Ltd
articles.headline: Nexera Technologies Signs Definitive Agreement to Sell KeepZone AI to a Global Aerospace and Defense Company for up to $6 million
articles.summary: Nexera announces an agreement to sell KeepZone AI for $1 million in acquirer securities plus a contingent earn-out of up to $5 million tied to future profits. It is a conditional agreement, not confirmation of a completed $6 million cash sale.
articles.timestampEvidence: The original distributor explicitly gives October 27 at 08:17 ET; indexed Yahoo syndication identifies EDT. The October 28 filing is a later publication and is not substituted for the release time.
